import os,time,json,sys
trace_path='C:\\Users\\Ant\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\mnemos-native-codex-stop-boundary-22kmbssb\\stop-python.jsonl'
def mark(stage, **fields):
    row={'stage':stage,'epoch_ns':time.time_ns(),'monotonic_ns':time.perf_counter_ns(),'pid':os.getpid(),**fields}
    with open(trace_path,'a',encoding='utf-8') as stream: stream.write(json.dumps(row)+'\n'); stream.flush()
mark('python_entry')
import base64,json,os,runpy;os.environ.update(json.loads(base64.b64decode('')));
mark('before_adapter_import')
import mnemos.adapters.codex as adapter
mark('after_adapter_import',origin=adapter.__file__)
original_run=adapter.run_hook
async def traced_run(event,payload,**kwargs):
    mark('run_hook_start',event=event,keys=sorted(payload))
    try:
        result=await original_run(event,payload,**kwargs)
        mark('run_hook_result',status=result.status,captured=result.captured,event_ids=result.event_ids)
        return result
    finally: mark('run_hook_end')
adapter.run_hook=traced_run
try:
    mark('adapter_main_start')
    status=adapter.main()
    mark('adapter_main_end',status=status)
    sys.stdout.flush()
    mark('stdout_flushed')
    raise SystemExit(status)
finally: mark('python_exit')
